claim_one_line: An outside referee re-derived about fifty of the paper's claims on a clean machine using none of this repository's code, found everything checkable correct, and found five defects -- every one verified here. WORST: the shipped verification package could not pass on a clean checkout, because the census evidence four locks read by name was excluded by .gitignore's blanket *.jsonl rule, and those are the locks for the one row of the paper that had to be withdrawn; fixed by a negation rule, with a scan confirming exactly one other lock names an untracked file and that one is correctly guarded. SECOND: the paper's census-drift figures (34.25 / 29.38 / 21.12 at depths 0, 20000, 80000) are a fact about the FULL orientable cusped census, quoted in a paragraph whose other rates are one-cusped; recomputed here by brute force over SL(2,3) images and independently by GAP GQuotients, the one-cusped census gives 33.00 / 33.88 / 31.38 -- flat -- so the decline is absent on the stated population. The paper now carries both triples and says which is which, and the consequence favours it: the 2T door is not an artefact of the census's small end. ALSO: the shipped REPORT.md was stale (54 claims against the manifest's 67) and said FAIL without naming the failing lock; the manifest recorded a commit that did not contain the artefacts it listed; sin^2 theta_W misses by 0.822 per cent and not the 0.9 stated in three places; and the paper had dropped Menal-Ferrer-Porti's n >= 2. The package's own failures are now named: six genuinely unrowed audit-seat pre-execution documents (rowed as received-and-not-read) and one subprocess lock whose timeout was tuned to an idle machine.
